ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct high-intensity white zones located on the medial sections of the left and right lobes. The left lobe zone is heavily mottled with dark, stochastic pixel clusters. The right lobe zone is a more continuous field bisected by dark linear features near its lateral boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile along the upper boundary; right lobe features a prominent, deep semicircular excision (notch) approximately 75% of the distance from the center to the tip. Lateral tips exhibit high-frequency rugosity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex curves toward the mid-lobe, and ending in irregular, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark pixel clusters (mottling) across the white field of the left lobe; smaller, isolated dark spots on the right lobe's medial white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Horizontal dark linear disruptions present on the right lobe white field, oriented perpendicular to the fluke's vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major semicircular tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive rugose, high-contrast texture on both distal tips consistent with dense barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, jagged lateral tip morphology on the left lobe, showing significant deviation from a smooth curve.
